run_mae_finetune_multinode: run multinode MAE finetuning on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer_job: submit a MAE finetuning Trainer job to a SLURM executor with GPU and memory parameters
parse_args_submitit: parse command line arguments for MAE finetune including ngpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and job_dir
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a Trainer checkpoint that requeues the job and resumes from the latest checkpoint file
get_init_file_dist: get a unique initialization file URI for distributed training across multiple nodes
